name: cc-setup-tooling
description: Fourteen skills that keep a Claude Code setup safe and tidy: review a third-party skill or plugin before installing it (skill-scan-gate, cc-plugin-lock and an offline inventory), lint SKILL.md front matter and fix its quoting, score descriptions against labelled prompts, estimate what a project loads on every turn, merge least-privilege permission rules and test them with claude-perm-sim, review the sandbox settings across scopes and flag what leaves it open, list the tool calls that would stop an unattended run on a permission prompt, show what each subagent can reach, add up the API usage in session transcripts and show which part moved, count shell commands that failed because of zsh, PowerShell or the Windows length limit, check what each compaction summary dropped, scaffold and test hooks with cc-hooks, find skills that collide or shadow each other, and find what breaks on other hosts and operating systems. Standard-library scripts, no network.
